plugins.name: hello
plugins.label: Hello, a plugin to copy
plugins.author: Shikshan Nivesh
plugins.what: The smallest plugin there is, here to be copied: one screen that reads a desk address, and one block a note can carry. Bring it in, open it, then change it.

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.label: Terminal door
plugins.author: Shikshan Nivesh
plugins.what: Lets the Ask box answer through an app already on this computer that you pay for another way (Claude Code on a Claude subscription, Codex on ChatGPT, Gemini CLI on a Google account), with the same screen data and your notes, so no separate AI key is needed.
talks_to: the coding agent on this computer, which reaches its own provider with its own login
